questions.stem: Why is there a slight delay between the contraction of the atria and the ventricles?

options.text: To give the coronary arteries time to supply the heart muscle
To allow the semilunar valves to open fully
To allow blood to return to the lungs first
To allow the ventricles to fill with blood before they contract

questions.explanation: The atrioventricular node (AVN) delays the electrical signal slightly, giving the ventricles time to fill completely with blood from the atria before they contract.
